crossRefs.note: Absalom said to Hushai, “Is this your kindness to your friend? Why didn’t you go with your friend?”

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: Mephibosheth
people.line: Son of Jonathan and grandson of King Saul.

translations.web: When he had come to Jerusalem to meet the king, the king said to him, “Why didn’t you go with me, Mephibosheth?”
translations.bsb: And he came from Jerusalem to meet the king, who asked him, “Mephibosheth, why did you not go with me?”
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when he was come to Jerusalem to meet the king, that the king said unto him, Wherefore wentest not thou with me, Mephibosheth?
translations.asv: And it came to pass, when he was come to Jerusalem to meet the king, that the king said unto him, Wherefore wentest not thou with me, Mephibosheth?
